Name: Crop Regrowth and Perennial Crops
Author: strobel1ght
Description:
[b][center][size=4][/size][/center][/b][b][center][size=4][/size][/center][/b][left][b][size=4]INTRODUCTION[/size][/b][/left][size=3]Some crops will now [/size][u]regrow[/u][size=3],[/size][size=3] some can be grown in[u] all seasons[/u], and some can [u]grow in winter[/u][/size][size=3].[/size]
[b]

1. REGROWTH[/b]

[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/d/db/Starfruit.png[/img]﻿ Starfruit
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/d/dd/Artichoke.png[/img] Artichoke
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/d/d1/Kale.png[/img] Kale
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/f6/Amaranth.png[/img] Amaranth
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/e2/Wheat.png[/img]Wheat 
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/6e/Rhubarb.png[/img] Rhubarb 
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/fe/Unmilled_Rice.png[/img] Rice


[b]2. MULTIPLE HARVEST
[/b]
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/f8/Corn.png[/img] Corn (will produce 1 to 2 corn per harvest with a 5% chance to produce an extra harvest)
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/e2/Wheat.png[/img] Wheat (will produce 1 to 2 wheat per harvest with a 10% chance to produce an extra harvest)
[size=3]
[/size]
[b]3. MULTI SEASONAL CROPS[/b]

[size=3][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/e2/Wheat.png[/img] Wheat - Spring, Summer, Fall
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/4/40/Bok_Choy.png[/img] Bok Choy - Summer, Fall
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/fe/Unmilled_Rice.png[/img] Rice - Spring, Summer
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/f6/Amaranth.png[/img] Amaranth - Summer, Fall
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/6e/Rhubarb.png[/img] Rhubarb - Spring, Winter
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/59/Hops.png[/img] Hops - Spring, Summer, Fall
[b][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/d/d1/Kale.png[/img] [/b]Kale - Spring, Fall, Winter
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/a/aa/Cauliflower.png[/img] Cauliflower - Spring, Fall, Winter[/size]


[b][size=4]CONFIGURATION[/size][/b][size=3]
The mod will create a [/size][b]config.json [/b][size=3]file in the mod folder after the initial launch. All regrowth options are set to [/size][u]'true'[/u][size=3] by default. Change the value to [/size][u]'false'[/u][size=3] if you want to disable regrowth for a particular crop.

[/size]
[b][size=4]MOD PREREQUISITES[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]

[b][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size][/b]
[size=3]1. Download `[CP] Crop Regrowth and Perennial Crops` 
[/size]2. Place [b]CropRegrowth [/b]in your /[b]Mods[/b] folder. (CropRegrowth contains both the Content Patcher and STF content packs)[size=3]
